errors.evidence: The two y-axes have different scales. The left y-axis (Recall@50) is scaled from 0.30 to 0.60, and the right y-axis (NDCG@50) is scaled from 0.15 to 0.22.
The blue solid line (NDCG@50 for Ours) plateaus at a value closer to 0.19 (approximately 0.188), not 0.18.

errors.text_span: stays constant at approximately 0.16 across all depths
errors.evidence: The blue dotted line (NDCG@50 for ReFICR) is constant at a value of 0.155, not 0.16.

errors.text_span: The plot demonstrates that ReDial (Ours) outperforms ReFICR in both metrics as the search depth increases
errors.evidence: This is an interpretive statement that is also factually incorrect. For the Recall@50 metric, the ReFICR model (green dotted line, ~0.46) outperforms the 'Ours' model (green solid line) at search depths 1 and 2.

errors.text_span: different models—ReDial, ReFICR, and their respective variants
errors.evidence: This phrasing is confusing. 'ReDial' is the title of the chart/system under test, while the legend specifies the methods are '(Ours)' and '(ReFICR)'. It incorrectly lists ReDial as a model on par with ReFICR.
